answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making admission a bridge of verified work rather than a simple sign-up. Each identity must spiral through a series of unpredictable tasks, each verified by random peers outside its cluster. A voyage of reputation builds only after repeated independent verification; a single failed audit burns the bond and resets progress. An honest agent crosses the bridge once; a swarm of clones must pay the toll for every fake key, turning sybil floods into an unaffordable toll.
